configurations.name: Trading Agent (Paper Mode)
configurations.description: Main trading agent scheduler — runs analysis cycles every 15 min during market hours (09:15-15:30 IST). Requires KITE_API_KEY, KITE_API_SECRET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env

configurations.name: Trading Agent (Live Mode)
configurations.description: Live trading agent — places real orders via Zerodha. Requires CONFIRM_LIVE_TRADING=true. Use only after validating paper trading results.

configurations.name: Kite Auth
configurations.description: Daily Zerodha authentication helper. Run once before market open each day. Caches access token for the session.

configurations.name: Backtest CLI
configurations.description: Strategy backtesting runner. Edit runtimeArgs to select strategy (mean_reversion, momentum, bollinger_squeeze, golden_cross, vwap_reversion) and data file.
